rationale: The Latin anchor *intendere* (to direct/apply the mind toward something) and the full Latin gloss *animum intendit* ("fixed/applied his mind on it") indicate a reflexive, attentive mental application — closely matching apply.v.10 ("apply oneself to"), rather than physical application or mere relevance. The OE a-þenian in this context conveys the stretching/directing of the mind toward what was heard.
